sources.title: AI Translator — Translate Text Privately with Local LLM
sources.snippet: How to aI Translator Install Ollama (ollama.com) and pull a multilingual model: ollama pull qwen2.5 Paste your source text into the left pane. Select the target language from the dropdown. Click Translate and copy the result.
